title: Пунктуация: запятая, точка с запятой, двоеточие, апостроф

why: Знаки препинания в английском работают иначе, чем в русском. У нас запятая стоит перед «что», «который», «чтобы» почти всегда, в английском перед that её нет. Зато нужны апострофы, которых в русском нет вообще. Правильная пунктуация делает письма и документацию понятнее и профессиональнее.
formation: • Запятая (,): после вводных слов (However, ...), после if-части в начале предложения, в перечислении (apples, bananas, and oranges), перед and / but / so, если они соединяют две полные части, и вокруг уточнений с which (Kyiv, which is the capital, is big).
• Точка с запятой (;): соединяет две близкие по смыслу полные части без союза (I was tired; I went home.) и стоит перед however (It rained; however, we went out.).
• Двоеточие (:): после полной фразы вводит список, пояснение или цитату (I need three things: a laptop, a charger, and a mouse.).

• Апостроф ('): сокращения (don't, it's) и принадлежность: единственное число 's (Anna's office), множественное на -s только ' (the engineers' office), нерегулярное множественное 's (the women's room).
usage: 1. Запятая отделяет вводное слово или условие. (Unfortunately, the server is down. — К сожалению, сервер не работает. If it rains, we'll stay home. — Если пойдёт дождь, мы останемся дома.)
2. Точка с запятой заменяет союз между двумя самостоятельными предложениями. (The server crashed; we lost all the data. — Сервер упал; мы потеряли все данные.)
3. Двоеточие вводит то, что идёт дальше. (He had one goal: to win. — У него была одна цель: победить.)
4. Апостроф показывает принадлежность или пропущенные буквы. (The company changed its logo. — Компания сменила логотип. It's raining. — Идёт дождь.)
signalWords: However, therefore, for example, unfortunately (после них запятая). Whose / who's, its / it's, your / you're (проверяй: можно ли развернуть в «is» или «are»).
mistakes: ✗ I think, that he is right → ✓ I think that he is right (перед that запятой нет, в отличие от русского «что»)
✗ I was tired, I went to bed. → ✓ I was tired, so I went to bed. / I was tired; I went to bed. (две полные части одной запятой не соединяются)
✗ The company changed it's logo → ✓ its logo (it's = it is, принадлежность без апострофа)
✗ two bug's → ✓ two bugs (во множественном числе апострофа нет)
✗ He is the developer, that fixed the bug → ✓ He is the developer who fixed the bug (перед who / that без запятой)
remember: В английском запятая не заменяет русскую перед that; its без апострофа это «его», it's с апострофом это «it is».

items.prompt: The company changed ___ logo. (a) its (b) it's
items.answer: its

items.prompt: ___ raining again. (a) Its (b) It's
items.answer: It's

items.prompt: The dog wagged ___ tail. (a) its (b) it's
items.answer: its

items.prompt: I think ___ a good plan. (a) its (b) it's
items.answer: it's

items.prompt: The two ___ laptops are on the table. (a) developer's (b) developers'
items.answer: developers'

items.prompt: My ___ husband is a lawyer (I have one sister). (a) sister's (b) sisters'
items.answer: sister's

items.prompt: ___ laptop is this? (a) Who's (b) Whose
items.answer: Whose

items.prompt: ___ late again. (a) Your (b) You're
items.answer: You're

items.prompt: However we decided to continue.
items.answer: However, we decided to continue.

items.prompt: If you need help call me.
items.answer: If you need help, call me.

items.prompt: I bought apples bananas and oranges.
items.answer: I bought apples, bananas, and oranges. / I bought apples, bananas and oranges.

items.prompt: Kyiv which is the capital of Ukraine is a beautiful city.
items.answer: Kyiv, which is the capital of Ukraine, is a beautiful city.

items.prompt: Unfortunately I missed the call.
items.answer: Unfortunately, I missed the call.

items.prompt: The deadline is tomorrow but we are not ready.
items.answer: The deadline is tomorrow, but we are not ready.

items.prompt: John come here please.
items.answer: John, come here, please.

items.prompt: Yes I agree with you.
items.answer: Yes, I agree with you.

exercises.instruction: Поставьте нужный знак: запятая (,), точка с запятой (;) или двоеточие (:)

items.prompt: I have three hobbies___ coding, hiking, and photography.
The server crashed___ we lost all the data. (без союза)
She was tired___ but she kept working.
Remember this___ never deploy on Friday.
The movie was long___ however, I enjoyed it.
If it rains___ we will stay home.
He had one goal___ to win.
I like tea___ my brother prefers coffee. (без союза)

exercises.instruction: Найдите и исправьте ошибку в пунктуации

items.prompt: I think, that he is right.
items.answer: I think that he is right.

items.prompt: I was tired, I went to bed early.
items.answer: I was tired, so I went to bed early. / I was tired; I went to bed early. / I was tired. I went to bed early.

items.prompt: The company is growing it's team.
items.answer: The company is growing its team.

items.prompt: There are two bug's in the code.
items.answer: There are two bugs in the code.

items.prompt: The womens' room is on the left.
items.answer: The women's room is on the left.

items.prompt: He is the developer, that fixed the bug.
items.answer: He is the developer who fixed the bug. / He is the developer that fixed the bug.

items.prompt: I need three things a laptop, a charger, and a mouse.
items.answer: I need three things: a laptop, a charger, and a mouse.

items.prompt: The students books are on the desk. (студентов несколько)
items.answer: The students' books are on the desk.

items.prompt: Я думаю, что он прав.
items.answer: I think he is right. / I think that he is right.

items.prompt: Это ноутбук, который я купил вчера.
items.answer: This is the laptop I bought yesterday. / This is the laptop that I bought yesterday.

items.prompt: Он сказал, что опоздает.
items.answer: He said he would be late. / He said that he would be late.

items.prompt: Это офис Анны.
items.answer: It's Anna's office. / This is Anna's office.

items.prompt: Если пойдёт дождь, мы останемся дома.
items.answer: If it rains, we will stay home. / If it rains, we'll stay home.

items.prompt: Мне нужны ноутбук, зарядка и мышь.
items.answer: I need a laptop, a charger, and a mouse. / I need a laptop, a charger and a mouse.

items.prompt: К сожалению, сервер не работает.
items.answer: Unfortunately, the server is down. / Unfortunately, the server is not working. / Unfortunately, the server isn't working.

items.prompt: Это офис наших инженеров.
items.answer: It's our engineers' office. / This is our engineers' office.
